description: Rules are matched in order against '<case>:<dataset>'; the first match applies. A dataset passes if max|a-b| <= atol + rtol * max|reference|. Values are about 10x the largest difference observed between the reference build and four variant builds of the same source (AppleClang -O0, LAPACK SVD, clang 22, GCC 15), rounded up; see PROVENANCE.md. The Legendre example is extremely ill-conditioned (minimal chi2 ~ 1e-17) and gets looser rules for its alpha probabilities and Ng.

rules.why: command-line output and exit code must not change
values below ~1e-12 are rounding noise (observed relative differences up to 1 at 1e-17)
observed 2.1e-5; values below 1e-30 are rounding noise (Legendre: 1e-43)
Legendre: the variance over alpha is <= 5e-15 (rounding noise); observed 5.3e-16
spectra, back-continuations, grids, all other outputs; observed 1.5e-7 (GCC 15, u2_time_fast)
